title: CobaltHealth integration sync — blockers, rollout plan, and SLO alignment
content:
Meeting: CobaltHealth weekly sync (Solutions Eng + ProServices)
Date: 2027-09-08, 10:00–11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #cobalthealth-onboard slack thread
Attendees: Aisha (SE), Marco (ProServices), Olivia (Platform Eng), Diego (SRE), Nora (CobaltHealth PM - on call), Eric (CobaltHealth infra)

Objective: Short triage of current blockers preventing stage->canary promotion, confirm SLO targets and rollback criteria, align on next 2-week runway for private deployment.

Quick status (TL;DR):
- Primary blocker: inter-VPC routing flaps causing sporadic 504s in canary (saw 1.6% error spike yesterday during perf run).
- Secondary: model-variant mismatch between on-prem quantized model and hosted test harness (KVM cache miss rate higher than expected).
- Data governance checklist mostly green; awaiting final signed BAA and one network access policy.

Agenda / Notes
1) Incident summary: intermittent 504s during canary perf runs
   - Diego ran packet captures (attached in slack). Pattern: flaps coincide with control-plane failover on Cobalt infra side (timing ~ 2–3s).
   - Hypothesis: heartbeat timeout between CobaltHealth LB and Redwood Private agent set to 5s; when control-plane re-elected, agent re-registers causing requests in flight to get dropped.
   - Immediate mitigation applied: increase agent health-check timeout to 12s and enable graceful-drain flag on agent restart (Marco).
   - Short-term result: latest perf run shows error spike reduced to 0.3% but still above 0.1% SLO.

2) Model runtime differences causing quality drift in private quantized variant
   - Olivia: quantized variant (int8 hybrid) on customer hardware shows KL divergence 0.06 vs hosted float baseline on eval set CH-PRDS-1 (threshold 0.04).
   - We discussed re-quantization with row-wise symmetric scale and re-running per-layer calibration; Diego suggested adding per-request temperature smoothing as a temporary band-aid.
   - Decision: schedule a small re-quant job to try symmetric-scale calibration (Olivia -> due 2027-09-14). If KL > 0.045 after recal, revert to 16-bit quant and accept marginal cost bump (fallback plan).

3) SLO alignment and rollback criteria
   - Customer target: 99.9% p99 < 400ms for inference (business ask). Our current p99 on canary is 460ms under their peak profile.
   - Agreed acceptance criteria for canary->prod:
     - p99 < 420ms for three consecutive 1-hour windows OR no single 1-hour window with error rate > 0.5%
     - No data-plane errors tied to TLS/mTLS handshake mismatches for a 24-hour observation period
     - Quality check: KL divergence <= 0.045 on representative eval suite (CH-PRDS-1).
   - Rollback triggers: any single hour with errors > 1.0% or p99 > 550ms for two consecutive windows -> automatic rollback to last stable variant + page SE oncall.

4) Networking / Private deployment runway
   - Eric (CobaltHealth) clarified they will schedule a maintenance window on 2027-09-12 to patch their LB. We aligned on running a controlled load test immediately after patch, with Redwood SRE observing.
   - Action: Diego to prepare a 3-stage load test plan and runbook (stages: smoke, ramp to 50% traffic, ramp to 100% traffic) by 2027-09-11. Include step to intentionally trigger agent re-registration and verify graceful-drain.

5) Security & compliance checkpoints
   - BAA status: legal countersigned draft pending two minor redlines; Aisha to coordinate with legal and Cobalt legal to close by 2027-09-10.
   - Audit logs: customer requested retention 2 years; current Private retention default is 90 days. Product ops to evaluate cost/ops impact and produce estimate (linked in confluence).

6) Observability gaps we need to close
   - Missing traces across agent restarts: Diego scoped a fix to persist small amount of trace context across agent reconnections (low-risk). PR JIRA: JIRA-CH-1078. Target: 2027-09-13.
   - Tokenized cost split for private deployment: request from customer to see token-level breakdown per route. We'll demo approximate estimates for week-of-2027-09-20.

Decisions made
- Increase agent health-check timeout to 12s and enable graceful-drain (temporary mitigation).
- Try symmetric-scale re-quantization; fallback to 16-bit if quality not acceptable.
- Formal acceptance criteria defined for canary->prod promotion (see SLO alignment).

Open questions / parking lot
- What is acceptable extra unit cost for CobaltHealth vs their business SLA? (Nora to provide expected budget delta by 2027-09-10).
- Should we support a hybrid routing policy (primary private, fallback to hosted for non-PII flows)? Engineering opinions: yes, but needs careful routing policy to avoid data exfil risk. (Follow-up w/ security).
- Can the customer extend audit log retention on their side instead of Redwood storing logs? Explore replayability vs raw logs.

Action items (owner, description, due)
- Marco Chen: implement graceful-drain on private agent and coordinate patch with CobaltHealth (done 2027-09-08).
- Diego Rivera: load-test runbook + 3-stage test plan; include reconnection trace (due 2027-09-11).
- Olivia Park: re-quantization job using symmetric-scale calibration; run eval suite CH-PRDS-1 and report KL (due 2027-09-14).
- Aisha Malik: finalize BAA redlines with legal + CobaltHealth legal, confirm signature (due 2027-09-10).
- Platform Ops (owner TBD): cost estimate for 2-year audit log retention for Private deployment (due 2027-09-17).
- Nora (CobaltHealth PM): confirm maintenance window on 2027-09-12 and share LB patch notes (due 2027-09-09).

Risks (short list)
- If re-quantization fails we accept higher memory footprint -> cost/perf tradeoff; could push p99 down but increase unit cost.
- Customer infra instability (unplanned failovers) can repeatedly block canary progress; need hardened graceful-drain to reduce impact.
- Legal delays (BAA) will block data onboarding; contingency is a limited sandbox dataset for early validation without PHI.

Notes to self (informal)
- Follow up with product on making agent health-check timeout configurable per-customer in Console (quick win).
- Consider adding a small test harness that intentionally reboots agent every X sec to exercise reconnect logic in CI for private deployments.

Attachments / artifacts referenced
- JIRA-CH-1024: CobaltHealth canary 504 spikes
- JIRA-CH-1078: persist trace context across agent reconnect (PR in progress)
- CH-PRDS-1: eval suite link in Confluence (see linked artifacts)

Next sync: 2027-09-15, same time. Propose an explicit 30-min tech-only war-room immediately after CobaltHealth LB maintenance to run the smoke tests and confirm metrics.

Meeting notes drafted by: Aisha Malik (SE)
